name: DREAM (Deepfake photoREalism AssessMent)
description: A benchmark for evaluating photo-realism and perceptual quality of deepfake images to assess detection and realism estimation methods.
evaluation_method: human_eval (with detection reported via accuracy and realism via correlation/MOS)
general_score_metric: mean opinion score (MOS) / Spearman/Pearson correlation (detection reported with accuracy)
reputation: A niche but recognized benchmark in media-forensics research for evaluating deepfake realism; moderate adoption within the deepfake detection community.
notes: Subjective human judgments drive the primary labels (human_eval); small/niche dataset sizes and annotator variability can limit reproducibility. Not an LLM benchmark; detection-specific metrics (accuracy/F1) are reported separately from perceptual scores.
